notes.title: Graphical update and small fixes for 1.0 release
notes.content: This is the major release of War War going off early access!  The game has now been graphically updated with some small bug fixes added as well!  I hope you all enjoy!

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.content: Hi guys.  This patch fixes a crash I found when placing new armies on the board in some situations.  It also updates the desert battlefield to have shifting sands up and down (for the non-opengl version)
